source.name: TGR Haas F1 Team – Partners: ZOOMEX
source.quote: Ahead of the 2026 FIA Formula 1 World Championship, TGR Haas F1 Team and ZOOMEX have renewed their partnership for a second year

note: Renewal for a second year ahead of 2026 implies a first year in 2025. ZOOMEX wordmark on a sleeve stack of the 2026 team shirt (store product photos).
